preconditions.description: Contract must be deployed with a floating pragma (^0.6.12) allowing compilation with different compiler versions
Different compiler versions may have different behaviors or security implications

exploit_hint: The floating pragma vulnerability is not directly exploitable through contract interactions but represents a deployment/development flaw. The contract uses ^0.6.12 which allows compilation with different compiler versions (0.6.12 to 0.7.0). This can lead to unexpected behavior if different compiler versions are used. To demonstrate the issue, one could show that the contract bytecode differs when compiled with different versions within the allowed range, potentially affecting contract behavior or introducing vulnerabilities.
